_what: Every entry setup_task_folder creates for one attempt, relative to the task folder (directories keep a trailing slash, the per-attempt .log is excluded).
_why: The judge reads this folder and nothing else. Pinning it means a change to what an attempt is graded from has to be deliberate, and it is what makes the local source provably interchangeable with the object-store one: tests_offline/test_offline_source_sink.py stages the same attempt both ways and asserts both listings against this file.
